scored_result.interpretation: TREATMENT FALSIFIED. Primary gate A1-A2 = +0.0431 < +0.05 (locked, not moved): real-target arm beats placebo only directionally, below bar. Secondary A1-A0 = -0.0472: the head co-train left emitted calibration WORSE than the head-off reference. The head learned answerability internally but the signal did not reach the emitted stated-confidence channel; the co-train instead nudged the action policy toward answering more. Consistent with the project's internal-vs-emitted three-channel dissociation.
